description.value: Topinoy is a takeout-only pizza and bubble tea spot in Tofino, launched in 2024 and quickly earning strong local reviews for its handcrafted pizzas made with fresh ingredients. It operates as a counter-service window — no dine-in, no delivery — making it a fast and convenient stop for cyclists passing through town. Bubble tea in multiple flavors rounds out the menu, offering a refreshing option after a long ride.
